topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influences frequency planning and spectral efficiency by allowing for a 52.9% relative bandwidth at broadside with an axial ratio (AR) lower than 3 dB. This enables efficient use of spectrum, adhering to the minimum bandwidth of 1 MHz for inter-satellite links, and supports high-throughput configurations with reduced link margin.
reference_context: The reference context discusses the performance of CTS antennas, inter-satellite communication, and satellite communication systems, highlighting the importance of bandwidth and spectral efficiency in broadband satellite links.
